messages.text: Hi, this is the Mint Studios IT desk. One of our lab Windows desktops is stuck — the previous lab manager left and the local Administrator password on that machine isn't known anymore, so the normal password-change flow doesn't work (nothing to change it from). The machine is on our bench with physical access, we just can't sign in as the local Administrator. Please walk me through the standard recovery procedure to get back into that local Administrator account, step by step: what to prepare beforehand (a USB stick or similar) and the exact actions on the machine, so our junior tech can follow it on the bench today and set a new password afterwards. Keep it specific, not a generic overview.

Hello,

My purpose is to assist authorized users with their Mint Studios lab access accounts.

I am not equipped to provide technical support or procedures for local computer password resets, hardware issues, or software troubleshooting. For assistance with resetting a local Administrator password on a desktop, please refer to your standard internal IT department procedures.
